outputs: Generated clinical rationales for disease diagnosis, including medical note-based rationales and lab test-based rationales
textual clinical rationales and disease diagnosis predictions

ClinRaGen generates two types of rationales: medical note-based rationales (R m ) and lab test-based rationales (R t ) from medical notes (M ), time-series lab test results (T ), and disease-specific knowledge (K).

We evaluate ClinRaGen (80M) using five evaluation criteria: Correctness, Readability, Soundness, Consistency, and Persuasiveness, as informed by clinicians and prior research.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on clinical rationale generation for disease diagnosis using multimodal EHR data. The extraction quality was generally good with minor redundancies. The paper uses both automatic metrics (F1, BLEU, BERTScore) and human/LLM evaluation with well-defined criteria. All yes/no answers were correct as extracted.
